title: ExtractRequest
description: The metadata part of `POST /extract`. The document bytes travel as the multipart `file` part; this object is the `metadata` part alongside it.

document_id.description: The `api`-side document id, echoed back on the proposal so a response can never be mistaken for another document's.

content_type.description: Media type `api` established by inspecting the bytes — not the type the uploader claimed.

filename.description: Original filename, for logging and prompt context only. Never used as a path.

base_currency.description: The organization's base currency, as a hint when the document itself is ambiguous.

correlation_id.description: Correlation id propagated from `api`, so one request is traceable across all three services (architecture C6).
